params.note: Synthesized recreation. Kick is a tuned sine with a fast pitch envelope, snare a tuned body plus filtered noise, clap a burst of noise gated three times then a tail.

caption.age7: Press the buttons. These are the drum sounds from a machine, not a real drum kit.
caption.age13: Turn the kick tuning down and the decay up. It stops being a drum and becomes a bass note. That single trick is most of hip-hop's low end.
caption.adult: Synthesized approximation of the TR-808 voice architecture. The tunable long-decay kick is the specific parameter that reframed the machine's perceived weakness as its value.
